rationale.edition: The only changed path is web/src/components/dashboards/panels/ChartRenderer.vue, which is open-source frontend (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or enterprise-owned modules). No enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo) appear in the path or symbol names, so the change is OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change alters user-facing dashboard chart behavior (the right-click context menu), there is no tests-added label or skip comment in the trigger, and no docs/CI-only nature. The diff does add code but no E2E spec, so the dev-authored-tests auto-skip rule does not apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: ChartRenderer.vue now enables the right-click 'read y-axis value' context menu for scatter charts (previously only bar/line). A user can exercise this new interaction on a scatter panel, so the UI flow changed and needs verification.
rationale.area: The bulk of the change lives in the dashboard chart panel renderer (web/src/components/dashboards/panels/), and sibling E2E specs for chart panels live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Charts is the existing matrix shard (actual_folder Dashboards) that already holds chart-panel specs like dashboard-multi-y-axis and dashboard-html-chart, making it the closest fit for a ChartRenderer context-menu change.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only changed file is ChartRenderer.vue (application code); no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were touched, so there is no existing Playwright coverage in the change to enhance.
